component.name: TBO
component.summary: Comic editor compatible with legacy TBO documents

description.p: TBO is a comic and cartoon editor originally written for GNOME in C. This is the modern reimplementation in Python and PyQt6.

It reads and writes the legacy .tbo format, offers an interactive canvas with pages and panels, supports text, image and SVG objects, provides a library of doodles and speech bubbles, and exports to PNG, PDF and SVG.
Development release of the Python/PyQt6 reimplementation.
